card.name: Linking words in web page teasers
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as about, will, you or a dash, at spots in web page text where a topic or name is about to be introduced. Also fires on a blank gap after a citation and on names like Purdue or psychology in headers.

modes.label: Linking words before a topic
modes.description: Words like about, will or you that lead into a described subject.
modes.example: It's<< about>> time, teachers, to honor our presidents

modes.label: Separators in page headers
modes.description: Dashes or header words in credit lines and navigation menus.
modes.example: E. Gregory Thompson, MD<< ->> Internal Medicine

modes.label: Read-more teasers
modes.description: The word about after 'Read more' in link blurbs.
modes.example: Read more<< about>> nerve symptoms symptoms What causes nerve symptoms
